cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Dr. Michael Watter, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, 1947; Sotheby Parke Bernet, Inc., New York, NY, sale 2600, lot no. 24, 19 October 1967; Mrs. Bernice McIlhenny Wintersteen, Villanova, Pennsylvania, 1967 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: O'Keeffe dates this 1931. In 1932 exh. of which we have no catalogue." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks associate it with 1931–32 New York (An American Place) exhibition, but it is not among works mentioned in criticism nor pictured in the installation photographs. Reproduced in *Vanity Fair* (April 1932). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
